Welcome to MVShort, the ultimate offline sanctuary for short film enthusiasts, independent cinema lovers, and avid film reviewers. Designed with a deep passion for the art of short filmmaking, MVShort offers a seamless, premium experience to catalog, manage, and track your ever-growing collection of short films right from your pocket.
In a world where feature films often dominate the spotlight, short films remain the unsung heroes of storytelling. They condense profound emotions, innovative concepts, and breathtaking cinematography into fleeting moments of brilliance. MVShort recognizes the unique value of these masterpieces and provides a dedicated platform to ensure they are never forgotten. Whether you are a professional critic analyzing every frame, a filmmaker drawing inspiration from your peers, or simply a fan of concise narratives, this application is tailored specifically to meet your needs.
One of the standout features of MVShort is its completely offline functionality. We understand that your passion for cinema doesn't stop when you lose internet access. With our robust local database architecture, you can add new entries, edit details, and browse your entire catalog without ever needing an active connection. Your data remains secure, private, and instantly accessible at all times, no matter where your cinematic journey takes you.
Our intuitive, beautifully designed interface allows you to effortlessly log comprehensive details for every film. You can track essential information such as the title, release year, genre, and your personal rating. Beyond the basics, MVShort empowers you to maintain detailed records of the cast and crew, acknowledging the talented directors, actors, cinematographers, and editors who bring these stories to life. The app also features a dedicated space for your personal reviews and notes, allowing you to capture your thoughts, interpretations, and critiques immediately after watching.
Customization is at the heart of the MVShort experience. With full support for modern iOS features like Dark Mode, the app seamlessly adapts to your viewing environment, reducing eye strain during late-night movie marathons. The layout is highly adaptable, offering both grid and list views to suit your organizational preferences. Furthermore, our robust statistics feature provides fascinating insights into your viewing habits, helping you track your favorite genres, highest-rated films, and overall watch time.
For those who value data security and portability, MVShort includes comprehensive backup and export tools. You can easily export your entire database to JSON or CSV formats, allowing you to seamlessly transfer your catalog to other devices or maintain a secure backup on your personal computer.
In essence, MVShort is more than just an app; it is a personalized archive, a critical companion, and a celebration of the short film medium. Start building your definitive short movie database today, and keep the magic of independent cinema alive, organized, and always within reach.

Teleprompter: Read & Film helps creators, teachers and small businesses read a script while recording video on iPhone or iPad. Paste text or import a TXT or text-based PDF, adjust the scrolling speed and text size, then record with your front or rear camera. Keep your take and save it to Photos or share it through Files and other apps. Three saved recordings are included at full quality, without a watermark. A one-time purchase unlocks unlimited new recordings. No subscription or app account is required.

PRACTICE THAT FITS YOUR DAY
Set an optional reading-time target and choose your available window. Compare six hourly start times, save a plan and optionally set one local reminder. Resume an unfinished rehearsal at your saved reading position. See completed rehearsals and kept takes in your weekly practice history.

READ COMFORTABLY
Set your scrolling pace, font size, line spacing and reading-column width. Place the script near the camera, pause the text without stopping the recording, or rehearse without using the camera. Mirror the script for compatible teleprompter glass.

RECORD AND KEEP YOUR TAKE
Use portrait or landscape recording at up to 1080p/30 on supported devices. See the recording time and microphone level, and choose a countdown before starting. The script and app controls do not appear in the saved video. Preview your take, keep it or discard it and try again.

USE A COMPATIBLE REMOTE
Control the prompter with supported Bluetooth keyboard/HID shortcuts. The in-app guide explains the supported commands. Remote capabilities vary by device; universal Bluetooth compatibility is not promised.

YOUR SCRIPTS AND RECORDINGS
Create and organize scripts locally. Import plain-text TXT files and PDFs that already contain selectable text. Preview extracted PDF text before saving. Scanned PDFs and DOCX import are not supported in this version. Core prompting and recording work offline; purchases, restoration and some external file providers require a connection.

CLEAR ONE-TIME TERMS
Script editing, importing, rehearsal and access to existing saved videos remain available without a purchase. Three kept recordings are included for the lifetime of the free allowance. Discarded previews and failed captures do not use the allowance. After that, one non-consumable purchase enables unlimited new recordings. Existing kept videos remain available to export. Restore Purchases is available in Settings.

Video capture requires camera and microphone permission. Saving to Photos asks for permission only when you choose that action. You can also save or share through Files. This version uses adjustable scrolling; it does not follow your voice, generate scripts, add captions or float over other apps.
